description: This file defines a lock-free multi-producer multi-consumer queue template class 'Queue' with associated 'Slot' and 'AlignedAllocator' classes, including memory alignment and false sharing prevention mechanisms.

classes.name: AlignedAllocator
classes.description: Allocator class that provides aligned memory allocation, using platform-specific aligned malloc functions.

classes.name: Slot
classes.description: Represents a slot in the queue, managing construction, destruction, and movement of stored objects with cache line alignment.

classes.name: Queue
classes.description: A lock-free, multi-producer, multi-consumer queue template class implementing concurrent enqueue and dequeue operations with false sharing mitigation.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory for T objects.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory allocated for T objects.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructs an object of type T in the slot with provided arguments.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the object stored in the slot.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves the object out of the slot.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Inserts a new object into the queue with perfect forwarding of constructor arguments.

methods.name: try_emplace
methods.description: Attempts to insert a new object into the queue without blocking.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Inserts a copy of the provided object into the queue.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to insert a copy of the object into the queue without blocking.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes an object from the queue and assigns it to the provided reference.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to remove an object from the queue without blocking.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the approximate number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the queue.
